checks.statement: target truncation lowers rank and creates a spurious class
two individually nonexact towers can combine rational-exactly
pairwise primitive circuits can miss a primitive kernel vector
adding a depth refines the Smith index without changing rational rank
source projection does not descend to the magnetic kernel
full-rank cutoff-dependent port gauges can break the reconstruction square
all-integer depth mixing creates a new single-port circuit
no hidden logarithmic divisor survives radial Hermite reduction

verdict: Eight hostile boundaries are reproduced exactly: target truncation, false depthwise cohomology, nonsaturated pairwise bases, independent arithmetic stabilization, forbidden source deletion, nonnatural port gauges, nonconservative integer-depth mixing, and hidden-divisor absence.
